process: Get the annual and monthly prices for all Relevance AI plans and any additions.
validation: Purchasables must include all of the following plans, prices and add-ons: Plans: Free, Pro and Team with monthly billing of $0, $29, $349 and annual billing of $0, $19, $234 a month. An enterprise plan with custom pricing (contact sales). Extra Actions as $40 per 1,000 actions. Extra Credits at $20 per 10,000 credits. If all were found at the given prices, validation is successful.
